description: This is a header file defining interfaces for executing Git commands, including setting paths, preparing commands, and executing them via system calls.

methods.name: git_set_exec_path
methods.description: Sets the execution path for Git commands.

methods.name: git_resolve_executable_dir
methods.description: Resolves the directory of the Git executable given a path.

methods.name: git_exec_path
methods.description: Returns the current Git executable path.

methods.name: prepare_git_cmd
methods.description: Prepares a Git command for execution, filling the output vector and argument vector.

methods.name: execv_git_cmd
methods.description: Executes a Git command with argument vector using execv system call.

methods.name: execl_git_cmd
methods.description: Executes a Git command with variable arguments using execl system call.

methods.name: system_path
methods.description: Returns the system path related to Git execution.
